ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution. Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate the central region and leading edges (approx. 55-60%). High-intensity (white) pixels are concentrated in the lateral lobe regions (approx. 40-45%), significantly interrupted by low-intensity mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone is a wide, solid black region bifurcating at the notch. Lateral lobes feature high-intensity white fields heavily interspersed with small, low-intensity contiguous pixel clusters (mottling). Distinct white patches are visible near the outer margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, shallow U-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees. The depth is minimal relative to the overall fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular and jagged trailing edge topography. High-frequency variations in pixel height (serrations) are visible across the entire span, with significant coarse peaks and valleys located near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave upward curvature from the median notch to the tips, while the leading edges show a steady convex sweep toward the posterior.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast pixel clusters at the distal tips of both left and right flukes, indicating localized colonization or calcified scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the upper-right lobe, appearing as three parallel unaligned pixel disruptions. Fainter, shorter linear disruptions are visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy erosion and irregular contouring at both fluke tips; significant stippled scarring across the ventral white patches.
other_distinctive_markers: The density of the fine-grained 'pepper' mottling on the right lobe is exceptionally high compared to the left, creating a localized drop in average pixel intensity for that quadrant.
